# Proto-Gospel of James Chapter 15 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalent)

**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** P.Bodmer V / Greek MSS, Proto-Gospel of James 15 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/POX_015_page_001.jpg

---

## Chapter 15

**15:1** Annas the scribe came to Joseph and asked: "Why did you not appear at our assembly?" Joseph said: "I was exhausted from the journey and rested the first day." Annas turned and saw that Mary was with child.

**15:2** He ran at once to the high priest and said: "Joseph, for whom you gave testimony, has committed a serious transgression." "In what way?" asked the priest. Annas said: "He has defiled the virgin whom he received from the temple of the Lord. He secretly consummated the marriage and concealed it from the children of Israel."

**15:3** The priest asked: "Has Joseph really done this?" Annas said: "Send servants to check, and you will find the virgin with child." The servants were sent and found it just as he had said, and they brought Mary and Joseph before the tribunal.

**15:4** The priest said to Mary: "Why have you done this? Why have you humbled your soul and forgotten the Lord your God? You were brought up in the Holy of Holies. You received food from the hand of an angel. You heard the hymns. You danced before them. Why have you done this?"

**15:5** Mary wept bitterly: "As the Lord God lives, I am pure before him. I have not known a man."

**15:6** The priest turned to Joseph: "Why have you done this?" Joseph replied: "As the Lord my God lives, I am pure with respect to her." The priest said: "Do not give false testimony — speak the truth. You secretly consummated the marriage and did not reveal it to the children of Israel, and you did not bow your head under the mighty hand so that your offspring might receive a blessing."

**15:7** And Joseph was silent.
